g.textArea: Hackathon | Organised by IEEE Student Branch
A 24-hour build challenge where student teams design and ship a working prototype. Mentors, meals, and prizes provided. Teams of 2 to 4 members from any department are welcome.

subgraph F4 [Flow 4: Event Registration] direction LR d1([Student Dashboard]):::terminator --> d2[Select Event]:::general --> d3[Event Details]:::general --> d4[Register Now]:::general --> d5([External Registration Website]):::external end
